attchmntText: BALAXI PHARMACEUTICALS LIMITED has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 12, 2026, titled "Balaxi Pharmaceuticals Limited Reports Strong Q2 FY27 Performance; Revenue Grows 45%, EBITDA Surges 338% and PAT Rises 450% YoY".
voiceSummary: Balaxi Pharmaceuticals Limited submitted its press release regarding unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. For Q2 FY27, revenue from operations was Rs. 8,137.23 lakh, up 44.85% year-on-year. EBITDA stood at Rs. 512.07 lakh, a 338.19% increase. Profit after tax was Rs. 115.01 lakh, rising 450.29%. Diluted EPS was Rs. 0.21. For H1 FY27, revenue was Rs. 16,205.40 lakh, up 27.68%. EBITDA was Rs. 978.31 lakh, up 83.99%. Profit after tax was Rs. 244.76 lakh, up 390.30%. Diluted EPS was Rs. 0.44. The results are available on the company website at www.balaxipharma.in.

attchmntText: Balaxi Pharmaceuticals Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Progress of the Company's Pharmaceutical Formulation Plant at Jadcherla, Hyderabad.
voiceSummary: Balaxi Pharmaceuticals Limited approved standalone and consolidated unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30 September 2026. The company also approved the change in designation of Mr. Pranav Maheshwari from Senior Vice President Business Development to President Business and Corporate Strategy, effective 12 November 2026. The Board noted progress at the Jadcherla manufacturing facility, including receipt of WHO-GMP certification from CDSCO. Commercial production is scaling up for Angola and Dominican Republic markets. The facility has manufactured 22 products, with the approved portfolio expanding to 34 products. Financial highlights for the half year ended 30 September 2026 include revenue from operations of 153837 lakhs and net profit of 72 lakhs. Cash and cash equivalents stood at 247.68 lakhs as of 30 September 2026.

attchmntText: BALAXI PHARMACEUTICALS LIMITED has informed the Exchange regarding ''RTA Report for Re-lodgement of Transfer Requests of Physical Shares for the period ended October 2026".
voiceSummary: Balaxi Pharmaceuticals Limited filed a report with the National Stock Exchange regarding the re-lodgement of transfer requests for physical shares. The filing is in compliance with SEBI Circular No. HO/38/13/11(2)2026-MIRSD-POD/I/3750/2026 dated 30th January, 2026. The report covers the period ended October 2026 and was received from the Registrar and Share Transfer Agent, M/s. Aarthi Consultants Private Limited. The data indicates that the number of requests received, approved, rejected, and processed during the month was NIL. The average time taken for processing requests was also NIL. The report is available on the company website at www.balaxipharma.in. The filing was submitted by Aman Purohit, Company Secretary and Compliance Officer.
